executionPolicy.effectiveFrom: Next implementation assignment or correction round after this policy is integrated; no retrospective execution claims
executionPolicy.unavailableBehavior: Report BLOCKED_NATIVE_AGENTS with the actual missing capability before dependent implementation; do not simulate independent agents
executionPolicy.evidence: Distinct native conversation IDs, assignment and owned paths, profile path/hash, inspected SHA, results, lead reconciliation

observedHashPolicy: Inventory snapshot, not an immutable version pin. Report the actual loaded hash and any drift; metadata names must match.

agency-software-architect.purpose: Toolchain compatibility within the approved architecture; no stack redesign.

agency-devops-automator.purpose: Reproducible runtime, CI, private deployment configuration, and operational failure evidence.

agency-backend-architect.purpose: Existing Module Interfaces, domain invariants, relational transactions, and server-side behavior.

agency-identity-access-engineer.purpose: The approved Better Auth login, MFA, session lifecycle, and record authorization.

agency-application-security-engineer.purpose: Task-scoped implementation checks for secrets, private files, input handling, and access control.

agency-test-automation-engineer.purpose: Meaningful scoped regression/integration/browser checks with actual results and NOT RUN limits.

agency-frontend-developer.purpose: The approved Arabic RTL screens, actual UI states, accessible interactions, and responsive behavior.

agency-accessibility-auditor.purpose: Observed keyboard, text scaling, focus, labels, and assistive-technology evidence; no unsupported compliance claim.

agency-database-optimizer.purpose: Existing PostgreSQL schema/index/constraint and concurrency correctness without replacing the database or adding infrastructure.

agency-security-architect.purpose: Check the already approved private-access and trust assumptions; no new architecture or compliance certification.

agency-document-generator.purpose: Arabic PDF layout and data agreement through the approved HTML/Playwright application path, without replacing it with another stack.

agency-database-reliability-engineer.purpose: The planned coordinated dump/files/key recovery and cutover; no replication, HA, or PITR expansion.

agency-reality-checker.purpose: Verify observed pilot evidence and disclose gaps; internal findings never grant Codex ACCEPTED or production approval.

agency-technical-writer.purpose: Clear scoped cutover/runbook and Arabic lawyer handover instructions using the actual accepted behavior.

T01.focus: Prove compatible pinned dependencies and the smallest strict build scaffold; do not redesign the stack or implement business features.

T02.focus: Local PostgreSQL/environment/readiness/CI foundation and isolated failure checks; no authentication or business CRUD.

T03.focus: Implement the accepted Better Auth/MFA/session policy; inspect direct-request authorization, secret handling, and recovery/revocation evidence.

T04.focus: Implement only the approved Arabic RTL shell/PWA and real state behavior; test keyboard/reflow and prevent confidential caches.

T05.focus: Party/identity/POA metadata and shared audit/idempotency; examine encryption-key handling, version conflicts, and actual isolated tests.

T06.focus: Matter/Proceeding/party relations, reference settings and migrations; preserve same-matter constraints and validate real PostgreSQL behavior.

T07.focus: Normalized bounded search and archive behavior using the approved Arabic screens and failure cases; no document-content search.

T08.focus: Atomic hearing result/next hearing/tasks/outbox plus usable mobile failure/retry states; no premature reminder worker.

T09.focus: Manual deadline confirmation, tasks and Cairo agenda states; never invent legal periods, dates, or completion evidence.

T10.focus: Durable PostgreSQL reminder jobs/leases/retries and worker failure evidence; no Redis, external delivery promises, or extra infrastructure.

T11.focus: Private upload/finalization and authorized preview; inspect fail-closed content validation and real negative cases. Owner-approved ADR 0003 defers malware scanning initially.

T12.focus: Immutable document versions, authorized metadata search/links and backup-safe cleanup without public exposure.

T13.focus: Exact EGP piastres, balanced fee posting/allocation/receipts and transactional concurrency; no tax or legal-revenue claims.

T14.focus: Separate reimbursable expenses, office costs and advances with locked balance checks and independent expected outcomes.

T15a.focus: Full correction reversals and allocation release; preserve immutable history and prevent duplicate actual cash effects.

T15b.focus: Actual partial/full refunds and fee adjustments with capacity/locking tests; do not substitute reversal for disbursement.

T15c.focus: Multi-client distribution, reconciled statements and restricted opening positions; no floating balances or fabricated history.

T16.focus: Generate the planned HTML/Playwright Arabic PDFs and private CSV/ZIP exports; inspect layout, totals, authorization and formula injection without changing stacks.

T17.focus: The accepted limited import template, clear Arabic preview and persistent replay/source-link checks; no universal migration engine.

T18.focus: Pinned private deployment configuration and isolated fault checks; no service purchase or live deployment without the existing explicit operational assignment.

T19.focus: Coordinate dump/files/manifest/key backup and clean restore drills with measured evidence; do not add HA, replication or PITR.

T20.focus: Observe the real lawyer pilot and record actual usability/accessibility findings; do not invent user participation, self-approve, or expand the UI.

T21.focus: Use accepted migration/opening commands and approved cutover/recovery gates; prepare the Arabic handover and reconcile actual authorized results.
